summary: Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. III (SVIII, a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 1 to the Business Combination Agreement with General Fusion Inc. and a newco, originally signed January 21, 2026. The amendment modifies the prior agreement under which SVIII will redomicile from Cayman Islands to British Columbia, then amalgamate with General Fusion via a plan of arrangement, with SVIII renaming to General Fusion Inc. Exact terms (price, premium, stake) are not stated in this excerpt. The board has not disclosed a new recommendation; no advisor named. The deal remains subject to shareholder approval and regulatory clearance. Watch for shareholder redemption levels; risk-arb spread depends on trust value per share vs. post-deal equity value.
